priority_scale.P0: Safety, permission, PIT, data integrity, core object chain or a hypothesis that unlocks many downstream tests.
priority_scale.P1: Decision-relevant and falsifiable after P0 dependencies close.
priority_scale.P2: Potential refinement with higher data or complexity cost.

active_path_policy.coverage_rule: Stop creating narratives once the frozen distinguishable path set plus OTHER_PATH covers material outcomes; update evidence instead.

failure_policy.single_delta_rule: Each retest version may change one primary theory layer and must declare unchanged invariants and an unseen chronology.
failure_policy.preservation_rule: Weak, contradicted, falsified, expired and superseded versions remain immutable and linked.
failure_policy.no_post_hoc_rescue: Do not change cohort, label, horizon, comparator, cost, feature family, wording or holdout after observing an evaluation outcome.

hypotheses.claim_text: A revision-aware available_at information set materially reduces hindsight leakage relative to current-value replay.
hypotheses.prediction_window: Dataset-wide replay comparison; no market return horizon is implied.
hypotheses.hard_falsifier: Any eligible feature consumes a record version with available_at later than decision_at.
hypotheses.expiry_rule: Expires when the bound source/replay schema changes.
non_trade_conditions: This is a data-validity hypothesis and never creates an order.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_discriminating_test: Synthetic revision and future-availability mutation test, followed only later by D1/D2 admitted artifacts.

lineage.notes: New P0 route; not a repair of the terminated raw-authority route.

hypotheses.claim_text: A fixed-role multi-timeframe state model improves out-of-sample state and decision quality versus a simpler single-timeframe baseline.
hypotheses.prediction_window: Frozen state-specific horizons from 15 minutes through 20 trading days.
hypotheses.hard_falsifier: On qualified out-of-sample windows, the simpler comparator is non-inferior on preregistered state and decision metrics while using less complexity.
hypotheses.expiry_rule: Expires when timeframe role or state-label version changes.
hypotheses.trade_link_or_none: Indirect; may constrain strategy family only after a later gate.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_discriminating_test: Synthetic clock/profile tests, then D3 baseline comparison without order execution.

lineage.notes: Current BTC role profile is a versioned candidate, not a universal fact.

hypotheses.claim_text: Past-only volatility-scaled zone position reduces low-value middle-location actions versus state-only decisions.
hypotheses.hard_falsifier: Random, shifted or exact-point baseline is non-inferior on preregistered out-of-sample decision metrics.
hypotheses.expiry_rule: Expires at zone invalidation, structural break or zone-contract change.
hypotheses.trade_link_or_none: Candidate location veto only; no direct order.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_discriminating_test: Synthetic invariance and shifted-zone controls before market evaluation.

lineage.notes: Zone position, strength, consumption and uncertainty must be separately measured.

hypotheses.claim_text: State-conditional RSI percentile, slope and divergence add stable decision information beyond structure and position; fixed RSI 30/70 or RSI-alone does not.
hypotheses.hard_falsifier: Qualified out-of-sample ablation shows no stable incremental proper score or net decision value over the same structure-and-position baseline.
hypotheses.expiry_rule: Expires when RSI formula, state profile, horizon or opportunity universe changes.
hypotheses.trade_link_or_none: Trigger observation only; permission, structure, utility and risk remain mandatory.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_discriminating_test: Four-way ablation: structure+position; plus fixed RSI; plus conditional RSI; full system without RSI.

lineage.notes: Preserves prior hypotheses while separating RSI observation from action permission.

hypotheses.claim_text: Non-overlapping post-impact resilience measurements help distinguish absorption/reversal from pressure continuation.
prerequisites: sequenced L2 or explicitly adequate response observations
hypotheses.prediction_window: Frozen post-pressure response and later outcome windows.
hypotheses.hard_falsifier: With qualified sequential response data and fair controls, resilience adds no stable discrimination over pressure-only baselines.
hypotheses.expiry_rule: Expires after the frozen response/outcome window or on any sequencing gap.
hypotheses.trade_link_or_none: Mechanism evidence only until mapped to a tested path and trade thesis.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_discriminating_test: Acquire only after D0-D2 a bounded strict-sequence source; compare strict R, pressure-only and no-R controls.

lineage.notes: January aggregated bookDepth proxy cannot establish order survival, cancellation or replenishment.

hypotheses.claim_text: Price, open interest, funding, basis and liquidation combinations improve mechanism ranking without identifying exact participant intent.
hypotheses.hard_falsifier: Qualified out-of-sample ablation shows no stable path or decision increment beyond price/volume state.
hypotheses.expiry_rule: Expires when contract, venue or funding regime changes.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_discriminating_test: After D3, ablate OI, funding, basis and liquidation one family at a time on a fixed universe.

hypotheses.claim_text: Finite path competition with OTHER_PATH and UNKNOWN_PATH improves scenario coverage, error detection or decision value versus single-narrative classification.
hypotheses.hard_falsifier: Same-information simpler baseline is non-inferior on proper scenario score, coverage-risk and net decision metrics.
hypotheses.expiry_rule: Expires when path library, scenario mapping or opportunity universe changes.
hypotheses.trade_link_or_none: Paths inform trade-thesis generation but do not directly grant action.
non_trade_conditions: UNKNOWN_PATH forced into a preferred class
hypotheses.next_cheapest_discriminating_test: Synthetic finite-coverage tests, then same-universe scenario comparison against a single-path baseline.

lineage.notes: OTHER_PATH, UNKNOWN_PATH and ABSTAIN are evaluated separately.

hypotheses.claim_text: Dependency-group-aware evidence aggregation reduces overconfidence without relying on selective coverage.
hypotheses.hard_falsifier: No improvement in out-of-sample reliability or tail calibration versus preregistered representative-variable and regularized baselines.
hypotheses.expiry_rule: Expires when dependency graph or aggregation rule changes.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_discriminating_test: Compare max-absolute, representative-variable and group-regularized aggregation after probability calibration is authorized.

lineage.notes: Not testable with primitive non-probabilistic mechanism support alone.

hypotheses.claim_text: Variable-duration partial-order paths are more stable than fixed-duration templates when compared at equal information and complexity.
hypotheses.prediction_window: Event-specific maximum duration frozen before outcome.
hypotheses.hard_falsifier: Same-information fixed-window or simpler FSM is non-inferior on stable out-of-sample metrics.
hypotheses.expiry_rule: Expires at maximum event duration or path-contract change.
hypotheses.trade_link_or_none: Event recognition only until a trade thesis is separately validated.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_discriminating_test: Synthetic variable-duration path tests and boundary perturbation before market data.

lineage.notes: The user example is methodology input, not an eight-day rule.

hypotheses.claim_text: After a high-participation downside shock near a past-only structural zone, weak downside efficiency plus later response confirmation may precede an upward transition.
hypotheses.prediction_window: Variable duration with frozen maximum bars.
hypotheses.hard_falsifier: Qualified data show effective zone loss and failed reclaim within the frozen window.
hypotheses.expiry_rule: Expires at maximum window without transition or on effective structural loss.
hypotheses.trade_link_or_none: Candidate long thesis only after separate trigger, utility, permission and risk gates.
non_trade_conditions: Only a doji or volume spike exists
hypotheses.next_cheapest_discriminating_test: Event-study design with continuation, balance and shifted-zone controls.

lineage.notes: One competitive path, not the default explanation.

hypotheses.claim_text: A high-volume rebound may be a temporary covering or event squeeze that fails to change the higher-timeframe down structure.
hypotheses.hard_falsifier: Price forms and maintains a preregistered upward transition with accepted higher low.
hypotheses.expiry_rule: Expires if neither failure nor transition occurs within the maximum window.
hypotheses.trade_link_or_none: Candidate short thesis only after failure trigger and risk/cost permission.
non_trade_conditions: news content used without market response
OI treated as exact covering proof
hypotheses.next_cheapest_discriminating_test: Outcome-free rebound event study comparing accepted transition, balance and failure.

hypotheses.claim_text: After shock and compression, price may enter a bounded balance rather than immediately continue or reverse.
hypotheses.hard_falsifier: Directional acceptance outside a frozen boundary with expanding efficiency.
hypotheses.expiry_rule: Expires on accepted break or maximum duration.
hypotheses.trade_link_or_none: Only boundary hypotheses; middle defaults to WAIT.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_discriminating_test: Compare frozen-boundary range detection to no-trade and trend baselines.

lineage.notes: Balance is a path, not proof of accumulation.

hypotheses.claim_text: Repeated weak rebounds at a structural zone may represent support consumption and precede a downside liquidity gap.
hypotheses.hard_falsifier: Rapid accepted reclaim and higher-low transition within the frozen response window.
hypotheses.expiry_rule: Expires if the zone is not retested within its validity horizon.
hypotheses.trade_link_or_none: Tail-risk control; short trade requires separate break-and-retest thesis.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_discriminating_test: Touch-sequence event study with random-zone and reaction-quality controls.

lineage.notes: Repeated tests can imply consumption or absorption; both remain competitive.

hypotheses.claim_text: Point-in-time event reaction and relative performance improve risk/state decisions; event text alone does not predict direction.
hypotheses.prediction_window: Predeclared event windows from 1 hour to 1 day.
hypotheses.hard_falsifier: With qualified clocks and matched controls, event reaction provides no stable risk or state increment and only increases opportunity cost.
hypotheses.expiry_rule: Expires after the predeclared event window or a new superseding event.
hypotheses.trade_link_or_none: Risk/state gate first; directional trade requires a separate thesis.
non_trade_conditions: latest revised macro value used historically
hypotheses.next_cheapest_discriminating_test: Verify one bounded official event series and vintage clock before any market outcome study.

lineage.notes: Success need not be directional alpha if tail-risk reduction is preregistered.

hypotheses.claim_text: Purged past-only nearest-state analog distributions add stable information beyond a frozen state baseline.
hypotheses.hard_falsifier: Purged out-of-sample analog is non-inferior or worse than the frozen state baseline across parameter neighborhoods.
hypotheses.expiry_rule: Expires when feature, distance, neighbor or shrinkage version changes.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_discriminating_test: Defer until simple state, path and calibration baselines are stable.

lineage.notes: Complexity is not justified before simpler models.

hypotheses.claim_text: Structural invalidation and monotone post-fill risk management improve cost-adjusted outcome versus fixed-percent stop and frozen-exit baselines.
hypotheses.hard_falsifier: Same-entry fixed stop/target or no-dynamic baseline is non-inferior after costs and tail risk.
hypotheses.expiry_rule: Expires on exit, invalidation or maximum hold.
hypotheses.trade_link_or_none: Future trade management only after E2/E3 authorization.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_discriminating_test: Synthetic invariants, then same-entry offline counterfactual comparison after E2 authorization.

lineage.notes: Target-extension policy variants must remain separate namespaces.

hypotheses.claim_text: Separating path quality, fill probability, no-fill cost, slippage, fees and funding materially changes action ranking.
hypotheses.hard_falsifier: On the exact target venue and order class, a simpler conservative cost model yields equivalent ranking and risk across qualified out-of-sample data.
hypotheses.expiry_rule: Expires when venue, fee tier, order type or latency profile changes.
hypotheses.trade_link_or_none: Execution modeling only after E3; no current action permission.
non_trade_conditions: market and execution venue differ without mapping
hypotheses.next_cheapest_discriminating_test: Defer to E3 after strategy-level evidence; first validate total synthetic order-state behavior.

lineage.notes: Execution evidence cannot be inferred from candles.

hypotheses.claim_text: The integrated state-to-finite-hypotheses-to-evidence-to-decision system adds stable net decision value versus simpler trend, range and no-trade baselines.
hypotheses.hard_falsifier: Qualified unseen evaluation shows no stable net benefit over simpler baselines after cost, risk, coverage and multiple-trial adjustment.
hypotheses.expiry_rule: Any component, label, opportunity, cost or policy change creates a new version.
hypotheses.trade_link_or_none: Future action system only after all independent gates.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_discriminating_test: Do not test until component hypotheses and simple baselines close.

lineage.notes: Highest-cost test and therefore deliberately last.

hypotheses.claim_text: The user example defines a universal fixed eight-day market rule.
hypotheses.hard_falsifier: The user explicitly stated that the eight-day sequence was an experience example, not a fixed-duration rule.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_discriminating_test: NONE; preserve as a counterexample against future misinterpretation.
